postprocess_qa_predictions_start_end_log: postprocess question answering model predictions by converting start and end logits to answer text substrings
postprocess_qa_predictions_with_negative: postprocess question answering predictions supporting datasets with unanswerable questions and null answer scoring
postprocess_qa_predictions_beam_search: postprocess question answering predictions from beam search models using top start and end log probabilities
postprocess_qa_predictions_save_json: postprocess question answering predictions and save results as JSON files to an output directory
postprocess_qa_predictions_nbest: postprocess question answering predictions and generate n-best candidate answers with probability scores
